note: Union County SD has no public queryable zoning district service. The county's 2008 zoning ordinance refers to an Official Zoning Map filed with the Register of Deeds (paper, no digital layer). North Sioux City publishes its zoning map only as a PDF/JPG (10-8-2025). Elk Point zoning appears only on a commercial aggregator (zoneomics). ArcGIS searches for Union County/Elk Point zoning returned no FeatureServer or MapServer. The county's ArcGIS experience viewer exposes parcels only, with no zoning layer found.
